== Summary ==
Identified, left to right: an unlabeled tall player in a white graphic tee and navy shorts; [[Kendall Halman]] (black polo and long hair); [[Brian Fred]] (Guns N' Roses Star Wars tee, glasses, no mask; same face as his named stills); [[Greg Shaw]] (blue Outrider Cup 2019 hoodie); [[Hayes Hunter]] (olive tee); and [[Jarad Konsker]] (maroon Deuce tee and glasses). The middle player is different in [[:File:2022 World Championship No Reverts 1.jpg]], where [[Karl Koenig]] stands in that shirt with a mask and long hair. The poster asked people to spot the difference.
The same "NO REVERTS!" caps group (second of two photos); the player in the middle is different. The poster asked people to "spot the difference".

* '''Event:''' [[2022 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-10-18
* '''Camera date:''' 2022-10-14 to 2022-10-16 (not stated)
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
